sv.title: Trump lanserar nya tullar
sv.summary: USA kommer att lansera tullar på upp till 20 procent mot EU. Mot Kina kan det bli upp till 40 procents tullar, enligt Bloomberg.

en.title: Trump launches new tariffs
en.summary: The US will launch tariffs of up to 20 percent against the EU. Against China, there could be tariffs of up to 40 percent, according to Bloomberg.
